title: Cosmoserve Space raises $6 million, sets up India's first space debris removal facility in Hyderabad
summary: Cosmoserve Space secures 6 million dollars to establish India's first space debris removal facility
detailed: The facility comprises an orbital rendezvous and capture lab, a space robotics innovation lab, an ISO Class 8 satellite integration clean room and a mission simulation and control centre.
